items.q: Where does WN Luxe focus in Phuket?
items.a: We focus on luxury pool villas around Pasak, Cherng Talay, Bang Tao, and the Laguna area on Phuket's west coast.

items.q: Can foreigners buy a villa in Phuket?
items.a: Many buyers use leasehold, company structures, or freehold where the title allows it. We explain options for each villa and always recommend independent legal advice before you sign.

items.q: Do you handle rentals as well as sales?
items.a: Yes. We list long-term and high-end rentals as well as villas for sale. Tell us your budget and move-in date and we shortlist homes that fit.

items.q: How do I book a viewing?
items.a: Send an enquiry on the listing page or contact us by email. We confirm a time, meet you on site, and follow up with photos or documents if you need them.
